target_customer: Recruiters, sales and GTM teams at startups and enterprises (named users include Mercor, Hud, Eragon, Corgi)
problem: Finding exact target people for recruiting or outbound is a slow manual process.
business_model: SaaS subscription, third party listing says from $75 per user per month (unverified)
product_category: AI people search and outbound prospecting

founders.name: Sid Rajaram
founders.background_notes: Education not listed on YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Natural language search over web and proprietary data with enrichment and email sending; standard stack with data sourcing as the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: Crowded prospecting category, data largely licensed or scraped.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action specific to Clodo found.

market_need_then: Outbound and recruiting teams spend heavily on prospecting tools; the company site claims 17,700 meetings booked and 1.5B+ people indexed, self reported.

identity.logo: A house with sunglasses, the original logo since founding per the site

brand_strength.rationale: Quirky logo, but the name is easily confused with Clado, Clodura and Clio in search results.

outcome_analysis: Clodo is an active Summer 2025 company in a crowded AI prospecting category with a two person team. It reports a customer list of YC startups and a partnership with a similarly named people search company, but no funding or outcome is verifiable.
notes: VCBacked, FundedIQ and Employbl list a $500K pre-seed (Sep 2025) with Y Combinator, seen only on aggregators, so unverified and not recorded as a round. Aggregators give conflicting descriptions (one says AI real estate assistant). A January 2026 item mentions an agreement with Clado that was not clarified. No competitor sources dated near the batch were found.
